Unknown/nontransient activity still yields; interrupted or deferred runs have a cooldown. No cross-process pass reuse, skipped bodies or deselection.
Passing requires actual exit zero, all collected nodes finalized, unconfigure seal, matching source/runtime and ownership; collection errors remain failures.
Valid YAML directives before a Chrome manifest version are accepted; malformed and nested variants remain rejected.
